description:
The process starts when an employee or department submits a request for an IT solution, such as new software or hardware.
IT assesses the request, checking for compatibility with existing systems and evaluating cost and resource needs.
If approved, IT procures the necessary tools or licenses, installs the solution, and tests it in a controlled environment.
After successful testing, the new solution is rolled out to the requesting department.
Training may be provided, and IT support remains available for troubleshooting.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ITSolutionRequest" name="IT solution request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequestSubmitted" name="IT solution request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_CheckCompatibility</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestSubmitted" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCompatibility" name="Check compatibility with existing systems">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_CheckCompatibility</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckCompatibility_EvaluateCost</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateCost" name="Evaluate cost">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckCompatibility_EvaluateCost</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EvaluateCost_AssessResources</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessResources" name="Assess resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EvaluateCost_AssessResources</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AssessResources_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_Approval_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AssessResources_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcureTools" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InstallSolution" name="Install the solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSolution" name="Test the solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Testing successful?" default="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RollOutSolution" name="Roll out the solution to the requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_Training</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training" name="Provide training?" default="Flow_Training_Omitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_Training</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Omitted</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Provided</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Provided_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Merge training paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Provided_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Omitted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideSupport" name="Remain available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Supported" name="IT support available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotApproved" name="Request not approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TestUnsuccessful" name="Testing unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CheckCompatibility" sourceRef="Start_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_CheckCompatibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCompatibility_EvaluateCost" sourceRef="Task_CheckCompatibility" targetRef="Task_EvaluateCost"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvaluateCost_AssessResources" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateCost" targetRef="Task_AssessResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssessResources_Approval" sourceRef="Task_AssessResources" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_ProcureTools">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">request is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="End_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_ProcureTools" targetRef="Task_InstallSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_InstallSolution" targetRef="Task_TestSolution"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_TestSolution" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Successful" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_RollOutSolution">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">testing is successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful" name="Unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="End_TestUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_Training" sourceRef="Task_RollOutSolution" targetRef="Gateway_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Provided" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">training is provided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Omitted" name="Training not provided" sourceRef="Gateway_Training" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Provided_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_ProvideSupport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_ProvideSupport" targetRef="End_Supported"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Requesting employee or department"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestSubmission" name="Submit IT solution request" sourceRef="Participant_Requester" targetRef="Start_RequestSubmitted" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
